digest.component_or_area: store initialization and ticket marker management
propositions: 119 .archived and 126 .write.lock files are committed and tracked in the tickets branch despite .gitignore patterns, causing git status to report dirty state and breaking the strict head check in plan_review/relation_snapshot.py

An ensure unit untrack-runtime-markers checks via git ls-files and removes tracked marker files with git rm --cached in batches, then commits once; the unit is idempotent and leaves worktree copies untouched

Peers merging the untrack commit have their worktree marker copies deleted by git, but the reader self-heals missing .archived markers by re-materializing them in reducer._api.py when a ticket is archived but the marker file is absent
The ensure unit implementation batches git rm --cached calls (batch=200) to stay under ARG_MAX and enumerates ls-files output to avoid pathspec failures when only one marker kind is tracked
